layers.name: Documentation & Governance
layers.description: Repository guides, plans, changelogs, and contributor-facing operating documents that explain how Artio is organized and maintained.

layers.name: Project & Tooling Config
layers.description: Top-level configuration, environment templates, analyzer settings, and build metadata that shape local development and automation.

layers.name: Main Flutter App
layers.description: Primary Artio client application code under lib/, including presentation, domain, data, shared core services, and app routing.

layers.name: Backend Edge Functions
layers.description: Supabase Edge Functions and shared server-side TypeScript modules that power generation, billing, rewards, and backend coordination.

layers.name: Data & Database
layers.description: Database migrations, SQL routines, and persisted schema artifacts that define Artio storage, policies, and server-side data behavior.

layers.name: Delivery & Automation
layers.description: CI workflows, scripts, and runtime infrastructure artifacts used to validate, package, or operate the repository outside the app runtime.

layers.name: Miscellaneous Root Artifacts
layers.description: Remaining repository-level files that do not fit a narrower application, backend, or infrastructure layer but still contribute to project operation.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the repository overview and contributor operating guide to understand Artio’s three surfaces, workflow rules, and architecture references.

tour.title: Main App Entry and Shell
tour.description: Inspect the main Flutter application entrypoint and top-level app shell to see how the primary client boots, configures providers, and connects routing.

tour.title: Design System and Shared Core
tour.description: Review shared core modules that provide design tokens, cross-cutting services, exceptions, and reusable state utilities used throughout the client surface.

tour.title: Backend Edge Functions
tour.description: Explore Supabase edge functions and shared helpers that implement generation orchestration, purchases, subscriptions, and reward flows on the server side.

tour.title: Database and Policies
tour.description: Study the SQL migration layer to understand how Artio models templates, profiles, credits, subscriptions, and access policies in Postgres.

tour.title: Automation and Operations
tour.description: Finish with repository automation, environment templates, and workflow artifacts that keep the project reproducible across local work, CI, and deployment.
